column1: # PULL LIST for a researcher at the National Archives, PRETORIA, Tuesday 22 September 2026.
# Depot TAB only. *** THIS ARCHIVE HAS NO SAB REFERENCES AT ALL - none, of any kind. ***
# Every reference below comes from NAAIRS and is recorded in data/naairs-lerena.tsv.
# *** NONE OF THESE HAS EVER BEEN ORDERED. *** The whole list is unspent.
# *** WHAT NO FILE ON THIS LIST CAN DO. *** A South African death notice asks for the deceased's
# PARENTS. It does not ask for grandparents. So the death notices of Pablo Armando's SONS will name
# Pablo Armando and Mary Septima Taylor - they will NOT name Juan Carlos Lerena. Nothing at TAB
# answers this archive's central question directly, and the researcher should not be told it might.

column3: LERENA, ROGUE LUIS ARMANDO - d. 29 Jan 1973, 20 Park Lane, Florida, Roodepoort; ID 331/402089
column4: *** HIS PLACE OF BIRTH. *** Born 6 December 1905 - FIFTEEN YEARS before his next-known brother, and three years before his father's 1908 Argentine enrolment was filed at the Cape Town office. If the notice says ARGENTINA it puts a second Argentine birth on record and dates the family's emigration to after December 1905. If it says Cape Town, the family was already settled there and the 1908 card was filed from a home rather than on arrival. *** Either answer is worth the trip. ***
column5: The DEATH NOTICE (Form J294) - first item in the file. Then the marriage block: he married TWICE, Rosina/Roseline Wilhelmina first, Rheena May second, and the notice should date both.
column6: HIGH - NAAIRS gives depot TAB, series MHG, clean

column3: LERENA, NUNO FERNANDO - d. 1 July 1971; surviving spouse Catherine Mary Sophia
column4: David's grandfather. His death notice names *** HIS PARENTS *** - expected PABLO ARMANDO LERENA and MARY SEPTIMA TAYLOR - with his own birth date and place. It is the only document that would put Pablo Armando's name into an official South African record written by his own family rather than by a clerk, and it independently tests the spine at its weakest documented joint.
column5: The DEATH NOTICE. Then the list of children / next of kin.

column3: GLYNNIS MARGARET LERENA (born BOLTON) versus ANTON ARMANDO LERENA - divorce
column4: *** WHO ANTON ARMANDO IS. *** He is the one man this archive cannot place: an estate advertised 2013 for a death in 2003, a 1977 debt case, and no parents. A divorce summons states the DATE AND PLACE OF MARRIAGE and usually the parties' ages; the order deals with the children. Between them they should fix his generation.
column5: The SUMMONS (particulars of claim) and the FINAL ORDER. *** Not the pleadings, not the discovery. ***
column6: MEDIUM - see the caveat row below

column3: RICARDO PAUL LERENA versus ANNE MARGARET LERENA (born CORBETT) - divorce
column4: *** WHO RICARDO PAUL IS *** - on the face of it a son of Ricardo Juan Carlos (b. 1920), carrying the Juan Carlos name into a third generation, which is this family's documented naming habit. Same two documents would date his marriage and name his children.
column5: The SUMMONS and the ORDER only.
column6: MEDIUM - see the caveat row below

column3: STADIUM TIMBER AND HARDWARE COMPANY LTD versus ANTON LERENA - claim for payment
column4: An ADDRESS and a DATE for Anton in 1977, and perhaps a trade or a business name. That is all a debt summons carries. *** This is the weakest file on the list and it is the one to drop first. ***
column6: MEDIUM - WLD is the Witwatersrand Local Division, sitting in Johannesburg; NAAIRS places the archived files at TAB, which this archive has not independently verified

column2: TAB TPD M680/1979 and TAB TPD 2769/1979
column3: Opposed applications, ANNE MARGARET LERENA versus RICARDO PAUL LERENA
column4: *** DO NOT ORDER. *** Both are interlocutory applications inside the SAME divorce as rank 4. Ordering them is paying three times for one dispute. Order them only if 1248/1979 turns out to be missing.

*** NAAIRS gives NO VOLUME NUMBER for any of the four court references *** - only a case number and a year. Estate files retrieve cleanly on MHG number; court files may need a volume traced at the depot. *** Tell her this before she goes. *** She would rather be told not to hunt than lose an hour, and if a volume is not obvious in ten minutes the file should be abandoned in favour of the two estates.

column3: Ricardo Juan Carlos 19962/95; Doreen May 16409/00; Pierre Frederick 2000; Paul Raymond 2001; Anton Armando 15127/2013; Roberto Juan Roque 017515/2022
column4: *** DO NOT SEND HER AFTER ANY OF THESE. *** They are known from Government Gazette notices, not from NAAIRS, and the NAAIRS Lerena series stops in 1980. Estates of this vintage should still sit with the Master of the High Court rather than the National Archives. *** This archive has NOT verified where the TAB cut-off falls, and says so rather than guessing. ***
